title: How smarter mobile crane maintenance keeps jobsites moving
summary: Grove offers a range of products that deliver tangible efficiency benefits around owning and operating cranes.They bring greater efficiency to issues such as boom lubrication, hydraulic pressure, and wire rope function, representing a significant opportunity for customers to improve crane uptime.
body_markdown:
## Addressing inconsistent boom performance


Poor lubrication is a common cause in declining boom performance. Telescopic sections operate under high loads and friction, so improper lubrication increases resistance and causes uneven movement. If it goes unmanaged, it leads to ‘boom slip’ and accelerated wear in pads and sections. For the operator, that translates to reduced control, slower operation, and, in the worst cases, an inability to telescope.


For technicians, the challenges of boom lubrication include ensuring even distribution and consistency, as well as reaching hard-to-access areas. To address this, Grove offers two specialized products: the Boom Grease Spray Set and the Boom Lubrication Kit.


With the Boom Grease Spray Set, a fine mist of high-density grease is delivered via an optimized pressure system that ensures the correct balance of grease and air. For the Boom Lubrication Kit, there’s a pneumatic pump paired with a variable-pressure spray gun that ensures even distribution. There’s also a long-reach spray lance to ensure full boom access, even on the inside via the TWIN-LOCK™ pinning holes. Both the Boom Grease Spray and Boom Lubrication Kit include Manitowoc-approved high-density grease that provides corrosion and wear protection while preventing boom slip.
